title: Surjectivity and kernel formula for completion projections.
statement: theorem flat_and_quotients_projection (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : C), Function.Surjective ((projection J A I n).hom.app (op U)) ∧ RingHom.ker ((projection J A I n).hom.app (op U)).hom = Ideal.span (Set.range (fun a : ↥(I ^ (n + 1)) ↦ (algebraSection (coefficientMap J A I) a).val (op U)))

proof.text: Lift the finiteSystem cone to the under-category of the constant ring, then obtain module, scalar-tower, flatness, transition-surjectivity and tensor-reduction data for the finite constant tower.
Apply sectionwise_adic_algebra_limit and transport its quotient equivalence along the limit-preserving forgetful functor from the under-category. This gives surjectivity of each original projection.
Use the named kernel component for the extended-power generator formula.

proof_origin: stage-3 proof via the sectionwise adic algebra limit theorem and named finite-system components
